pr_title: Fix edge cases which allow very short slider placement in editor
pr_body:
Could lead to a game crash.

---

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/32295#issuecomment-2709707937.

Addresses both dragging for more repeats on the slider in the provided `.osu` file, as well as getting into that state in the first place.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f7ca9b7e-562d-4bb2-80d2-443a26ba7415

issue_context.title: Trying to make reverse zero-length slider crashes the game
issue_context.body:
### Type

Crash to desktop

### Bug description

Rarely during mapping a zero-length slider can get placed (i don't know how to get it consistently, it just happens sometimes). If I try to add reverse arrow to it by dragging the slider tail in the timeline, the game crashes.
There's a [related issue that's marked as closed](https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/25886), but the bug isn't actually fixed.

### Screenshots or videos

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/770b0700-9dad-4625-a8f8-bf6339f2b1c1

### Version

2025.306.0-lazer

### Logs

[compressed-logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19144095/compressed-logs.zip)
